summary: claude-study-room's dashboard is a single-file Node http server (`src/dashboard.ts`, 60 KB, 1166 lines) that serves a static SPA from `webui/` (index.html 31 KB + dashboard.js 75 KB, no build step) and exposes a flat `Record<"METHOD /path", handler>` route table (dashboard.ts:947-1097). It owns no domain state of its own: it reads a JSON snapshot the engine writes (`~/.claude-study-room/<repo-slug>/status.json`), reads per-repo `taskmap.json`, shells out to `gh`/`app-testing-agent`, and spawns the engine + Editor as `ManagedProcess` children whose stdout is tee'd into an 800-line in-memory ring plus `~/.claude-study-room/engine.log`. Telemetry is two-tier: a LIVE in-memory fold in `src/live.ts` (`recordUsage`, live.ts:2072-2099) that updates a per-student grid card and a role×tier `attribution` matrix, and a DURABLE append-only `usage.jsonl` written by `src/usageStore.ts` (#297). The live half dies with the engine process and `status.json` is overwritten zeroed on the next boot; the durable half is one ~250-byte line per completed student run and — critically — has no reader anywhere in the codebase. There is no run-level record of duration, session id, diff, PR URL, outcome, or cost; the only narrative of a run is grep-able prose in `engine.log`, and the only full transcript is Claude Code's own `~/.claude/projects/<cwd-slug>/<sessionId>.jsonl` (286 project dirs on this machine, ~0.5-1.7 MB per session), which is an accident of the harness being `claude` and breaks the moment OpenCode runs a lane. Seven screens exist (Pool, Task Map, Plan, Protector, Editor, Revamp, Admissions), all polling GET endpoints on 1.5-10 s intervals with `cache: no-store`. The Electron wrapper (`electron/main.cjs`) is a tray app that spawns the same `src/dashboard.ts` using Electron's own binary as Node (`ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1` + bundled tsx) and passes `SR_ENGINE_CMD`/`SR_ENGINE_TSX` so the dashboard can spawn the engine the same way in a packaged app with no Node on PATH.
facts: HTTP server + route table: `src/dashboard.ts:1107-1160`. Routes are a flat map keyed `"${req.method} ${url}"` (dashboard.ts:947, 1111-1112) — exact string match, so no query strings and no path params are supported anywhere.

Port: `const PORT = Number(process.env.DASHBOARD_PORT || 4600)` (src/dashboard.ts:40). DISCREPANCY: `run-dashboard.cmd` sets `DASHBOARD_PORT=4700` and `electron/main.cjs:15` defaults to 4700, so `npm run dashboard` alone binds 4600.

Config file env: `const CFG = process.env.RUNNER_CONFIG || 'config.json'` (dashboard.ts:43); repo override via `process.env.RUNNER_REPO` (dashboard.ts:106, 1109). Config is re-read from disk on EVERY request (dashboard.ts:1109).

GET /api/status (dashboard.ts:948-969): returns the parsed `status.json` verbatim, plus `annotateReroles()` tagging, plus an injected `body.protector = { running, repo, repos[], optimizationMode, autoMerge, reviewMode, maxParallel, scheduledStartAt, draining, testRun, testRunLabel }` (dashboard.ts:955), plus a live override of `pool.maxConcurrent` and `pool.tiers[haiku|sonnet|opus].{model,maxWarm}` from config.json (dashboard.ts:960-967). Falls back to `EMPTY = {updatedAt:null, stopped:true, pool:{running:false,maxConcurrent:0,tiers:{},students:[],attribution:{}}}` (dashboard.ts:131-134) when status.json is missing.

status.json on-disk shape (written by `writeStatus` in src/index.ts:58-77, verified against ~/.claude-study-room/default/status.json): `{updatedAt, stopped, pool:{...PoolState, maxConcurrent, tiers}}` where PoolState = `{running, students[], attribution, protector, parallelism:{effective,configured}, boardHealth, capacity?}` (live.ts:2673-2691).

Student card shape in status.json: `{id, tier, model, role, state:'busy'|'idle-warm'|'asleep'|'recycling', task, taskId, tokens, cacheHitPct, ticksLeft, effort?, fastMode?}` (live.ts:2036-2049, 2661-2672).

Attribution matrix cell shape: `attribution[role][tier] = {tasks, tokens, cost, cacheReadTokens, cacheInputTokens}` — folded in memory at live.ts:2079-2084. `cost` is `taskCost(tier,u)` = estimated equivalent API $, explicitly NOT billed on a CLI subscription (src/pricing.ts:10-19, 29-42).

GET /api/log (dashboard.ts:971): `{ lines: string[] }` — last 400 lines of the Protector `ManagedProcess` ring. Ring cap is 800 lines (managedProcess.ts:47,87-88) and is also tee'd to `~/.claude-study-room/engine.log` (dashboard.ts:169,172).

GET /api/board (dashboard.ts:973 → buildBoard at 675-721): `{ items:[{kind:'issue', repo, number, title, stage:'ready'|'blocked', deps:number[]}], fetchedAt, repos:string[], errors:Record<repo,msg>, error? }`. Fetches every configured repo concurrently via `fetchIssues(slug)`; a failing repo is reported by name and does not blank the board.

GET /api/taskmap (dashboard.ts:978-992): `{ repos:string[], sections:[{repo, tasks:(Task&{repo})[]}], tasks:(Task&{repo})[], blocked:Record<'<repo>#<id>',boolean> }`. `tasks`/`blocked` are the flat union kept for older callers.

Task shape (src/taskmap.ts:28-39): `{id, title, model:Tier, role:Role, priority:number, deps:string[], pinned:boolean, assignedStudent:string|null, stage:'ready'|'implementing'|'review'|'fixing'|'merging'|'done', difficulty?, owns?:string[]}`. Role union = `'triage'|'implement'|'review'|'fix'|'rewrite'|'resolve'|'merge'` (taskmap.ts:23).
GET /api/editor/status (dashboard.ts:994-999): `{ running:boolean, log:string[] (last 200), handoff:string (raw HANDOFF.md), configRepo:string }`.
GET /api/gh-status (dashboard.ts:1003): `{ login: string|null, error? }`. POST /api/gh-login (dashboard.ts:1004): `{ok,msg}` — opens a terminal running `gh auth login --web`.
GET /api/editor/presets (dashboard.ts:1006-1011): raw `editor-presets.json` from cwd, default `{systemTypes:[],lenses:[],learned:[]}`.

GET /api/revamp (dashboard.ts:1071 → testingAgent.ts:readRevampState): `{configured:boolean, revamp:RevampReport|null, error?}`. RevampReport = `{generatedAt, app, url, units, plan:{goal,budget,spent,accepted[],deferred[],overall?}, screensInventoried[], reportPath, screenshots[]}` (testingAgent.ts:56-70). Shells `npx tsx src/cli.ts export --sections revamp --compact` in the agent checkout, 30 s timeout (testingAgent.ts:32,181).

POST /api/revamp/run (dashboard.ts:1072-1075): body `{url, budget}`; URL validated against `/^https?:\/\/[\w.-]+(:\d{1,5})?(\/[\w./-]*)?$/` (testingAgent.ts:43) because `shell:true` is required for npx on Windows. Runs `npx tsx src/cli.ts revamp --json --url <u> --budget <n>` with a 10-minute timeout (testingAgent.ts:34).

GET /api/admissions (dashboard.ts:1080-1084): `{report: AdmissionsReport|null, running:boolean, split:{running:boolean, log:string[] (300)}}`. POST /api/admissions/scan and /apply (1085-1086) run the same sweep with `apply=false|true`. POST /api/admissions/split body `{dryRun, limit, model}` (1087, startSplit at 877). POST /api/admissions/split/stop (1088).

POST control routes, all returning `{ok:boolean, msg:string}`: /api/pool/start (1015-1019), /api/pool/test-run `{n:number, unit:'pr'|'merge'}` (1034-1045), /api/pool/test-run/cancel (1046), /api/pool/stop (1051), /api/pool/drain (1052), /api/pool/drain/cancel (1053), /api/pool/schedule `{minutes}` (1054), /api/pool/schedule/cancel (1055), /api/editor/stop (1056), /api/editor/start `{goal,repo,cwd,model,maxInstances,maxIssues,budgetTokens,park}` (1057, signature at 376), /api/taskmap/op `{repo, op, ...}` (1058, applyTaskMapOp at 786), /api/pool-config `{maxConcurrent, haiku, sonnet, opus, maxParallel}` (1059, setPoolConfig at 727-756), /api/automerge `{on:boolean}` (1060), /api/reviewmode `{mode:'auto'|'human'}` (1061), /api/optimization `{mode:'speed'|'token'}` (1062), /api/board/unpark `{repo,number,target:'issue'|'pr',label}` (1066, unparkItem at 767-785, refuses any label not in PARKED_LABELS), /api/config `{repos:string[]}` or `{repo:string}` (1093-1096).
Cache policy: NO_STORE set covers the 9 GET endpoints (dashboard.ts:1101-1105); mutating POSTs get no cache header.

Error handling: a throwing handler answers 500 `{ok:false,msg:detail}` and logs, deliberately not fatal (dashboard.ts:1120-1127). An unknown `/api/*` path answers 404 `{ok:false, unknownRoute:key, msg:'...restart the dashboard...'}` rather than the HTML shell (dashboard.ts:1140-1148) — because webui/ is read from disk per-request while routes are compiled into the running process.

Static serving: `serveStatic` resolves under WEBUI_DIR with a containment check, `cache-control: no-store`, unknown extension falls through, text files pass through `themed()` (dashboard.ts:89-103). Unknown non-API paths fall back to /index.html (dashboard.ts:1157).

Seven screens, toggled by `showScreen(s)` (webui/dashboard.js:492-514) against nav buttons at webui/index.html:104-112: pool, taskmap, plan, protector, editor, revamp, admissions. Task Map has two sub-views, `deps` and `workflow` (index.html:236-239, dashboard.js:515-522).

Poll intervals (webui/dashboard.js:825-829): `pull()` (/api/status) every 2000 ms, `pullLog()` (/api/log) every 1500 ms, `pullTaskMap()` every 2000 ms, /api/board every 10000 ms when on plan, /api/editor/status every 2000 ms when on editor, renderProtector every 2000 ms, gh-status every 15000 ms when on pool. `renderSchedule` every 1000 ms (dashboard.js:97). Admissions polls every 2500 ms while on that screen (dashboard.js:1129).

Pool screen stat tiles (index.html:191-198): Busy, Idle-warm, Asleep, Recycling, Total tasks, Tokens processed, Cache-hit %, "Est. API $ · not billed". Chart metrics are `[['tasks','Tasks'],['tokens','Tokens'],['cacheHit','Cache-hit'],['cost','Est. $*']]` (dashboard.js:11) sliced by role (`chartRole`) — all derived from the in-memory attribution matrix, so all reset to zero on engine restart.

Protector screen (dashboard.js:861-900) renders the assignment ladder: exact / rerole / cross-repo / spawn / wait + `warmReuseRate` = (exact+rerole+crossRepo)/placed (assignments.ts:118-127). Source is `AssignmentSnapshot {tallies, recent, rebalances, warmMap, waitsByReason}` (assignments.ts:80-86) carried inside status.json.
AssignmentLog rings are in-memory only, cap `MAX_RECENT = 200` (assignments.ts:21, 95-96, 105-112). Nothing persists them apart from being spread into status.json each snapshot.

Durable usage store: `src/usageStore.ts`. Path `join(homedir(), '.claude-study-room', 'usage.jsonl')` (usageStore.ts:103-105), engine-wide (not per-repo) on purpose (usageStore.ts:28-34). Written synchronously with `appendFileSync`, NEVER throws (usageStore.ts:148-156).

UsageRecord fields (usageStore.ts:82-97, verified against the live file): `{ts, repo, item, role, tier, model, harness, fidelity, inputTokens, outputTokens, cacheReadInputTokens, cacheCreationInputTokens, turns, stoppedBy}`. Real line: `{"ts":"2026-09-11T17:08:29.244Z","repo":"Pat201492/dungeonworks","item":254,"role":"implement","tier":"opus","model":"claude-opus-4-8","harness":"claude-code","fidelity":"exact","inputTokens":1231,"outputTokens":64220,"cacheReadInputTokens":3449184,"cacheCreationInputTokens":149746,"turns":27,"stoppedBy":null}`.

`UsageFidelity = 'exact' | 'partial' | 'missing'` (usageStore.ts:58-70), derived from `harness.capabilities.cacheUsageSplit` via `fidelityFor()` (harness.ts:105-107) so an adapter cannot claim exact by omission. Rationale on record: 95% of all tokens across 69 real sessions were cache reads, so mapping a flat total onto `inputTokens` overprices a warm session by ~an order of magnitude (usageStore.ts:36-52).
usage.jsonl is WRITE-ONLY: grep across src/, test/ and root *.ts finds only `usageStore.ts` (writer) and `test/usageStore.test.ts`. No endpoint, no dashboard screen, no CLI reads it.
Live file state: `C:\Users\pegan\.claude-study-room\usage.jsonl` is 2162 bytes = 7 records, all 2026-09-11, all repo `Pat201492/dungeonworks`, all harness `claude-code`, fidelity `exact`.

recordUsage is the single fold point (live.ts:2072-2099): updates `display.tokens`/`display.cacheHitPct`, caches into `this.lastUsage` (live.ts:149), increments `attribution[role][tier]` (tasks/tokens/cost/cacheReadTokens/cacheInputTokens), then calls `recordUsageToStore(role, tier, usage, {harness: harness.id, fidelity: fidelityFor(harness), ...ctx})`.

`UsageContext` requires `{repo, item}` and optionally `{model, turns, stoppedBy, harness, fidelity}` (usageStore.ts:72-80). Call site example: live.ts:2190-2193 passes `{repo: rs.slug, item: n, model: cfg.pool[tier].model, turns: result.turns, stoppedBy: result.stoppedBy}`.

`CliTaskResult = {text, usage:CliUsage, sessionId, turns, stoppedBy?}` (cliStudent.ts:27-36). `sessionId` is parsed from `parsed.session_id` (cliStudent.ts:487,507) but is NEVER persisted for board students — only `src/editor.ts` persists a sessionId, into `editor-status.json` (verified: `"sessionId":"86d6e2f8-651f-422d-8547-3effff671f8f"` in ~/.claude-study-room/Pat201492-claude-study-room/editor-status.json).

`CliUsage = {inputTokens, outputTokens, cacheReadInputTokens, cacheCreationInputTokens}` (cliStudent.ts:20-25). Derived metrics: `tokensProcessed = input+output+cacheRead` (pricing.ts:54-56), `cacheHitPct = cacheRead/(input+cacheRead+cacheCreate)*100` (pricing.ts:64-66), `taskCost` prices cache write at 1.25x input and cache read at 0.1x input (pricing.ts:24-25, 33-42). Prices per 1M: haiku {1,5}, sonnet {3,15}, opus {5,25} (pricing.ts:20-23).

Harness seam: `Harness {id, capabilities, run(), killAll(), isCapacityError()}` (harness.ts:81-94). `HarnessCapabilities {warmSessions, seedableSessions, cacheUsageSplit, toolAllowlist, budgetStop}` (harness.ts:37-68). Registered: `claude-code` (all five true, claudeCodeHarness.ts:32-38) and `opencode` (`{warmSessions:true, seedableSessions:false, cacheUsageSplit:true, toolAllowlist:false, budgetStop:false}`, openCodeHarness.ts:87-93). `getHarness(id)` THROWS on an unknown id rather than defaulting (harness.ts:141-147).

State dir layout, `C:\Users\pegan\.claude-study-room`: engine-wide files `engine.log` (5,208,011 bytes), `usage.jsonl` (2,162 B), `admissions.json` (20,200 B), `admissions-split.log` (7,755 B), plus (per dashboard.ts:170-171,270,864) `editor.log`, `editor-auto.json`, `scheduled-start.json`. 30 per-repo dirs, two naming generations: legacy `Pat201492-<repo>` (17 dirs, from `repo` short-slug) and current `https---github.com-Pat201492-<repo>` (12 dirs, from the full URL through `.replace(/[/:]/g,'-')`).

Per-repo state dir contents (repoState.ts:111-112, 223-262; verified on `https---github.com-Pat201492-dungeonworks`): `attempts.json` (109 B, `{"Pat201492/dungeonworks:issue-288":2,...}`), `lifetime.json` (146 B, all-time attempt counts), `handled.json` (129 B, `[1,2,3,16,...]` issue numbers PR'd), `quarantine.json` (2 B `{}`), `status.json` (23,935 B), `taskmap.json` (12,890 B), `repo/` (full clone), `worktrees/` (14 dirs incl. `study__issue-114`, `_pr124`, `_review125`).

status.json is written ONLY for `config.repo` (src/index.ts:53-56) even on a multi-repo config (`repos: ["Pat201492/equipworks","Pat201492/dungeonworks"]` in config.json). Evidence: `.../https---github.com-Pat201492-equipworks/status.json` is 8,163 B dated Sep 11 13:32 (live) while `.../dungeonworks/status.json` is 23,935 B dated Aug 24 — a stale orphan from when config.repo pointed there.

`writeStatus` deliberately SPREADS PoolState rather than enumerating fields (index.ts:62-74), because hand-enumeration silently dropped the Protector assignment telemetry (#126) on the way to disk. It is called on every state transition via `runner.onChange = () => writeStatus(runner.snapshot())` (index.ts:254) plus at boot/tick/shutdown (index.ts:268, 280, 314, 324, 346, 352).

engine.log is an unstructured tee: each line is `<ISO ts> <ANSI-colored logger line>` (managedProcess.ts:101-110, logger.ts:14-22). Tail shows the only run narrative that survives: `✓ #288 PR opened: https://github.com/Pat201492/dungeonworks/pull/298`, `✓ #297 review: APPROVE`, `✓ #297 merged (squash) — <title>`, `↻ IMPLEMENT #255 → opus-2 (exact, opus/implement)`, `▶ #255 implement (opus) → study/issue-255`, `=== Protector exited (code 0) ===`. 20 s heartbeat lines (`Ingested 33 issues…`) dominate the volume.

Claude Code transcript location: `C:\Users\pegan\.claude\projects\<cwd-slug>\<sessionId>.jsonl`. 286 project dirs. Slug = the student's cwd with `\`, `:`, `.`, `/` collapsed to `-`, e.g. `C--Users-pegan--claude-study-room-https---github-com-Pat201492-dungeonworks-worktrees-study--issue-18`. That dir holds 5 JSONL files, 501 KB-1.66 MB each, one per session uuid.

Transcript JSONL event types observed in one 492-line file: `assistant` (246), `user` (101), `last-prompt` (27), `queue-operation` (14), `attachment` (12). Common envelope on user/assistant/attachment records: `{parentUuid, isSidechain, uuid, timestamp, sessionId, version:"2.1.158", cwd, gitBranch:"study/issue-18", userType:"external", entrypoint:"sdk-cli", permissionMode:"bypassPermissions"}`.

Transcript assistant record: `{type:'assistant', requestId:'req_...', message:{model:'claude-opus-4-8', id:'msg_...', type:'message', role:'assistant', content:[{type:'thinking'|'text'|'tool_use', ...}], stop_reason:'tool_use'|..., stop_sequence, stop_details, usage:{...}, diagnostics}}`. Per-assistant-message `usage` fields: `input_tokens`, `cache_creation_input_tokens`, `cache_read_input_tokens`, `output_tokens`, `server_tool_use:{web_search_requests, web_fetch_requests}`, `service_tier:"standard"`, `cache_creation:{ephemeral_1h_input_tokens, ephemeral_5m_input_tokens}`, `inference_geo`, `iterations:[{input_tokens, output_tokens, cache_read_input_tokens, cache_creation_input_tokens, cache_creation, type}]`, `speed:"standard"`. Real sample: `{"input_tokens":1140,"cache_creation_input_tokens":26561,"cache_read_input_tokens":10243,"output_tokens":1312,...}`.

`queue-operation` record: `{type, operation:'enqueue', timestamp, sessionId, content:<prompt text>}`. `last-prompt` record: `{type:'last-prompt', lastPrompt, leafUuid, sessionId}` — no envelope fields.

usageStore.ts:16-26 states on the record that the 2026-08-31 cost-per-acceptance-criterion analysis had to RECONSTRUCT spend by parsing `~/.claude/projects` transcripts (cost_extract.py, comparator.py, ratio.py) and that this only works "by accident of every student being a `claude` process that happens to write transcripts to a path we know" — that accident ends the moment a second harness runs a task.

electron/main.cjs:22-42: `spawn(process.execPath, [TSX_CLI, 'src/dashboard.ts'], {cwd: APP_ROOT, env:{...process.env, ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE:'1', DASHBOARD_PORT:String(PORT), RUNNER_CONFIG:'config.json', SR_ENGINE_CMD: process.execPath, SR_ENGINE_TSX: TSX_CLI}, windowsHide:true})`. TSX_CLI = `<app>/node_modules/tsx/dist/cli.mjs`.

electron/main.cjs:46-62 `stopDashboard()` uses `spawnSync('taskkill', ['/PID', pid, '/T', '/F'])` on win32 (deliberately sync — `before-quit` does not await an async spawn, #64/#66). main.cjs:64-80 `waitForServer` polls `http://localhost:<PORT>/api/status` 60 times at 500 ms, then shows an error dialog. main.cjs:110-119 tray menu: Open dashboard / Start pool (POST /api/pool/start) / Stop pool (POST /api/pool/stop) / Quit. main.cjs:123-135 single-instance lock; window close hides to tray.

dashboard.ts:212-218 `startPool()`: if `SR_ENGINE_CMD` + `SR_ENGINE_TSX` are set, spawns `engineCmd [engineTsx, 'src/index.ts', '--config', CFG, '--live']` with `ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1`; otherwise `process.execPath ['node_modules/tsx/dist/cli.mjs', 'src/index.ts','--config',CFG,'--live']` with `shell:false` (the vendored tsx, never `npx`, because a GUI/Scheduled-Task PATH is thinner than a shell's).

run-dashboard.cmd: defaults `DASHBOARD_PORT=4700`, `RUNNER_CONFIG=config.json`, `LOG=dashboard.task.log`, `MAX_RESTARTS=10`. Single-instance guard via `netstat -ano | findstr ":%DASHBOARD_PORT% " | findstr LISTENING`. Re-entrant helper modes `openbrowser` (60 curl polls of /api/status then `start http://localhost:<port>`) and `poolstart` (30 polls then `curl -X POST /api/pool/start -d "{}"`, opt-in via `--start-pool` or `SR_AUTOSTART_POOL=1`). Runs `"%NODE%" node_modules\tsx\dist\cli.mjs src\dashboard.ts >> LOG 2>&1` in a restart loop.

run-dashboard.cmd treats exit codes `-1073741205` (0xC000026B window station shutting down), `-1073741502` (0xC0000142), and `1073807364` (0x40010004 DBG_TERMINATE_PROCESS) as Windows session teardown and does NOT restart — because restarting into a dying session collapses the 5 s backoff to ~30 ms and burns the whole restart budget in a third of a second. Its `:sleep` uses `ping -n` not `timeout.exe`, because timeout.exe refuses to run with stdin redirected (which is exactly how a shortcut/WMI/tool launch invokes it).

package.json: `"dependencies": {"tsx": "^4.19.2"}` — a single runtime dependency, no DB driver. Scripts: `start`(tsx src/index.ts), `dashboard`(tsx src/dashboard.ts), `electron`, `dist`(electron-builder --win nsis), `test`(node --import tsx --test test/*.test.ts), `typecheck`. electron ^33.2.0, `"asar": false`, `engines.node >= 20`.

`src/logger.ts` is 21 lines: ANSI-colored `log.info/ok/warn/err/step`, timestamp `new Date().toISOString().replace('T',' ').slice(0,19)`. No levels, no structured fields, no sinks — everything goes to `console.log` (even `err`).

`src/roleView.ts` (48 lines) is presentation-only: `ROLE_SINGULAR: Record<Role,string>` and `computeReroles(prev, students)` → `{reRoledFrom, next}`, a pure function so the re-role transition rule is unit-testable without a server or browser. Consumed by `annotateReroles(body)` in dashboard.ts:145-168 and driven off the /api/status poll.

`src/testingAgent.ts` is a versioned-envelope client, NOT a file reader: `AGENT_SCHEMA = 'app-testing-agent/export/v1'` and `parseEnvelope` hard-fails on a version mismatch naming both versions (testingAgent.ts:29, 158-163). Agent path comes from `config.testingAgent.path`; readiness is `existsSync(join(path,'src','cli.ts'))` (testingAgent.ts:97-99).

reusable.what: Append-only per-run usage ledger: UsageRecord type, UsageFidelity tri-state, toUsageRecord() (pure, testable), appendUsage() (never throws), recordUsageToStore().
reusable.why_keep: This IS the v2 run ledger's first draft and its rationale is already written down and defended (fidelity segregation, engine-wide not per-repo, telemetry must never fail a task). v2 should extend the record, not redesign the contract.
reusable.coupling: Imports only node:fs/os/path + ./logger, and types from ./taskmap (Role), ./pricing (Tier), ./cliStudent (CliUsage). Lifts out cleanly; path is injectable for tests.

reusable.what: taskCost(tier, usage) with cache multipliers (write 1.25x input, read 0.1x input), tokensProcessed(), cacheHitPct(), PRICE_PER_MILLION per tier.
reusable.why_keep: Pure, 70 lines, zero imports, unit-tested (test/pricing.test.ts). The comments encode the hard-won distinction between estimated-equivalent-API-$ and plan-usage headroom, which any v2 cost column must preserve.
reusable.coupling: No imports at all. Only coupling is the hardcoded three-tier `Tier` union, which v2 must widen for non-Anthropic providers.

reusable.what: Declared-capability harness registry: Harness interface, HarnessCapabilities (warmSessions/seedableSessions/cacheUsageSplit/toolAllowlist/budgetStop), fidelityFor(), getHarness() that throws on unknown id, killAllHarnesses().
reusable.why_keep: The multi-harness seam is the reason a run ledger needs a `harness` column at all, and the capability→fidelity derivation is what stops v2 pooling unpriceable numbers with priceable ones. Already a DAG with a documented reason for the file split.
reusable.coupling: harness.ts imports only types from cliStudent + usageStore. claudeCodeHarness/openCodeHarness pull in the actual CLI runners. The interface layer lifts out; the adapters carry their engines.

reusable.what: Pure AssignmentLog: ladder tallies (exact/rerole/crossRepo/spawn/wait), warmReuseRate KPI, bounded recent/rebalance rings (MAX_RECENT=200), warmMap(supply vs demand per repo×tier×role).
reusable.why_keep: No clock, no I/O — callers pass `at` in, so it is replayable from a ledger. If v2 persists assignment events, this module becomes a pure projection over them with no rewrite.
reusable.coupling: Imports types from ./pricing, ./pool, ./protector. Trivial to lift.

reusable.what: Bounded log ring (default 800 lines) fed by stdout+stderr, optional tee to a log file, graceful stop, taskkill /T /F on win32 else SIGTERM.
reusable.why_keep: Single implementation of child-process lifecycle for both the engine and the Editor; it exists precisely because there used to be two copies that drifted. v2 still needs to spawn and reap an engine.

reusable.what: computeReroles() — pure re-role transition detection over consecutive snapshots + ROLE_SINGULAR labels.

v2_implications: KEEP the usage.jsonl contract's three invariants verbatim: (1) telemetry writes NEVER throw and never fail a task (usageStore.ts:137-156), (2) fidelity travels with the numbers and is DERIVED from harness capability, not passed by hand (harness.ts:105-107), (3) a run that reported nothing is still recorded, with zeros and fidelity:'missing', so it stays in the $/AC denominator (usageStore.ts:113-118). All three are defended with measured evidence in-file.

ADD the six fields that make a row answer 'what did it do': `runId` (uuid, minted at dispatch not completion), `startedAt` + `endedAt` (durations are currently unrecoverable — only completion `ts` exists), `sessionId` (already in `CliTaskResult.sessionId`, thrown away at live.ts:2190), `transcriptPath` (the engine already knows cwd and sessionId; storing the resolved `~/.claude/projects/<slug>/<sessionId>.jsonl` removes the reconstruction hack usageStore.ts:16-26 warns about), `cwd`/`worktree` + `branch`, and `outcome`.

`outcome` must be an explicit enum, not inferred from engine.log prose. Minimum set observable today: `pr-opened` (+prUrl, +prNumber), `empty-diff` (live.ts:2214-2219 already distinguishes two kinds of empty diff), `review-approve` / `review-changes-requested`, `merged`, `budget-stopped` (already `stoppedBy:'budget'`), `idle-killed` (onIdleKill at live.ts:2178), `capacity-blocked`, `infra-failure` (isInfraFailure at live.ts:2129), `error` (+message). Plus a diff shape: `filesChanged`, `insertions`, `deletions` — cheap to get from the commit the student already makes (live.ts:2195-2196).

SPLIT tokens four ways and NEVER collapse them: `inputTokens`, `outputTokens`, `cacheReadInputTokens`, `cacheCreationInputTokens` (already correct). 95% of all tokens across 69 real sessions were cache reads (usageStore.ts:44-47), so a two-field total silently overprices warm runs ~10x. v2 should additionally persist `turns` (already there) plus `tokensProcessed` and `cacheHitPct` as stored derived columns, since those are what the dashboard tiles show and recomputing them per row per poll is the current design's cost.

CARRY provider explicitly, not just `model`. Today `harness:'claude-code'|'opencode'` and `model:'claude-opus-4-8'` are the whole identity, and `tier:'haiku'|'sonnet'|'opus'` is an Anthropic-shaped enum baked into pricing.ts:1 and taskmap.ts. v2 needs `{harness, provider, model, tier?}` with tier optional/nullable, or the OpenCode lane (#299/#300) cannot be priced or grouped at all.

STORE cost, do not recompute it. `taskCost()` prices against a table that changes; a row priced at write time with a `pricingVersion` stamp stays reproducible, while recomputing on read silently rewrites history when the table is edited. Keep the pricing.ts warning in the UI: this is estimated equivalent API $, not billed on a subscription login (pricing.ts:10-19).

PERSIST the assignment ladder as events, not just as a live counter. `exact|rerole|cross-repo|spawn|wait` and `warmReuseRate` are the KPI that says whether the warm pool is working at all (assignments.ts:114-127), and today they are a 200-entry in-memory ring that resets every boot. Writing one row per placement decision (runId, kind, fromRole, waitReason, workerId, tier, role, repo) makes AssignmentLog a pure projection with zero rewrite.

LINK to the transcript rather than copying it. Transcripts are 0.5-1.7 MB per session and 286 project dirs already exist; the ledger should store the path + sessionId + a byte/line offset, and v2 should offer a `GET /api/runs/:id/transcript` that streams/pages it. Do NOT parse transcripts as the source of truth for usage — the harness's own final JSON result is authoritative and harness-neutral.

CHOOSE SQLite for the query store, keep JSONL as the write path. The dashboard's queries are aggregations the JSONL shape cannot serve cheaply: role×tier attribution matrix (7 roles × N tiers, SUM/COUNT), per-repo and per-harness rollups for the #301 comparison, cost-per-merged-AC (a join between runs and outcomes), a recent-runs feed with paging, and time-range filters — all polled every 2 s. A JSONL answer is a full-file rescan and reparse per poll; usage.jsonl is unread today partly because that is awkward to write. Concretely: one `runs` table + one `assignments` table, WAL mode, indices on `(ts)`, `(repo, item)`, `(harness)`, `(role, tier)`, `(outcome)`; the append-only .jsonl stays as the crash-safe/exportable mirror so a corrupt DB never loses samples and the file remains greppable.

GUARD the SQLite decision against the packaging constraint. The repo has exactly ONE runtime dependency (`tsx`) and ships as an Electron NSIS installer with `asar:false`; `better-sqlite3` is a native module needing an Electron-ABI rebuild in the electron-builder pipeline, and `node:sqlite` needs Node 22+ while `engines.node` is >=20 and Electron 33 bundles Node 20.18. Either pin the toolchain or accept a native rebuild step — this must be decided before the storage choice is committed.

REPLACE the exact-match router. `ROUTES["${method} ${url}"]` (dashboard.ts:1111) cannot express `GET /api/runs?repo=x&since=y&limit=50` or `GET /api/runs/:id`, which is the minimum surface a run ledger needs. Keep the two behaviours that were earned: a 500 that keeps the server up (dashboard.ts:1120-1127) and an explicit 404 that names the stale-process cause instead of returning the HTML shell (dashboard.ts:1140-1148).

MAKE status.json a projection, not the archive. Keep it as the ~2 s live poll payload (it is cheap and the UI is built on it), but stop treating the attribution matrix inside it as the system of record — the matrix should be `SELECT role, tier, count(*), sum(tokens), sum(cost) FROM runs WHERE ...` so the Pool screen's tiles survive an engine restart, which they do not today.

FIX the multi-repo status path while rewriting. index.ts:53 keys the snapshot on `config.repo` alone; the pool is global but the snapshot is filed under one repo, producing stale orphan snapshots for every other configured repo. Either file it engine-wide (matching usage.jsonl's reasoning at usageStore.ts:28-34) or write one per repo.

NORMALISE the state-dir naming in a migration. Two slug generations (`Pat201492-x` vs `https---github.com-Pat201492-x`) currently split one repo's history across two folders. A run ledger keyed on `repo: 'owner/name'` (which usage.jsonl already uses correctly) sidesteps this for telemetry, but the per-repo files (attempts/lifetime/handled/quarantine/taskmap) still need one canonical key.

KEEP the launcher scars. Any v2 launcher must retain: the netstat single-instance guard, the capped restart loop, the three session-teardown exit codes that must NOT trigger a restart, `ping`-as-sleep (timeout.exe fails with redirected stdin), the vendored-tsx spawn (never `npx`, PATH is thinner under GUI/Task launches), and the synchronous `taskkill /T /F` on Electron `before-quit`. Each is documented inline as a fix for an observed failure.
